I have enough grounding across the contract, dataloader, dump contract, tests, and the Gregor reference. Here is my ROUND 1 adversarial audit.

# ROUND 1 — `omnifold_contract_auditor` audit of the proposed PyTorch PET2 estimator

**Scope reviewed (read-only):** `AGENTS.md`; `nd-unfolding/PET_UQ_REMEDIATION_STATUS.md`; `nd-unfolding/pet/FULL_EVENT_FEATURE_CONTRACT.md`; `docs/GREGOR_FOUNDATION_MODEL_REFERENCE.md`; `nd-unfolding/pet/fullevent_fps_dataloader.py`; `nd-unfolding/pet/fullevent_dump_contract.py`; `nd-unfolding/pet/dump_pointcloud_inputs.py`; `nd-unfolding/pet/test_g2_fullevent_dump_schema.py`; `nd-unfolding/tests/test_fullevent_dump_contract.py`; `nd-unfolding/tests/test_fullevent_gate2.py`.

## 0. What the repository *actually* establishes (the contract the proposal must honor)

These are load-bearing and non-negotiable. The proposal is measured against them, not against AUC.

- **Three distinct, non-mirrored schemas.** reco cloud / measured (data) share **one identical observable schema**; truth cloud is distinct; event_reco/event_data share one schema, event_truth is distinct. "No manufactured counterparts" — MINOS/range/quality/reco-vertex have **no truth counterpart** and must never be synthesized (`FULL_EVENT_FEATURE_CONTRACT.md:100-102, 147-151`; leakage guards `fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:182-199`; C++ negative guards `test_g2_fullevent_dump_schema.py:249-277`).
- **The current reco cloud is GENERIC, not typed.** Tokens are recoil clusters `(E, pos, z)` + parallel `view` (1=X/2=U/3=V) + `time`; the **muon is a distinguished *event* (FiLM) feature, not a cloud token**; there is no per-token PID/type (`dump_pointcloud_inputs.py:64-73`; contract `:79-114`). The proposal's "typed muon/photon/blob/prong tokens" is a **representation rewrite of the reco side**, not an add-on.
- **Truth-authoritative selection + native misses.** Truth-denom walked first; reco filled only for keyed truth-pass events; truth-only events appended as native misses; `|mc_signal_reco| == |mc_truth_denom|` by construction (`AGENTS.md:74-91, 253-273`; `dump_pointcloud_inputs.py` header comment). Reco muon/vertex/cloud are **SENTINEL −9999 / zeroed on `!pass_reco`** (`test_g2_fullevent_dump_schema.py:286-290`; `_reco_row` `dump_pointcloud_inputs.py:270-285`).
- **Density-ratio direction.** Step-1 reweights reco↔data (detector manifold, KNN coord = `(pos,z)`); step-2 reweights gen↔truth (angular KNN coord). event_reco/event_data are pure detector functions (`assert_no_truth_leakage`, `fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:182-199`). Edges are **reporting/covariance only, never inputs** (`:63-86`).
- **Background = Option-A literal negweight injection + Stay-Positive**, POT-scaled `−w_bkg·pot_scale`, refined per-replica, fail-closed without aligned background clouds (`FULL_EVENT_FEATURE_CONTRACT.md:47-59`; `build_fullevent_loaders:560-670`). Generator labels `bkg_nuPDG/current/inttype` are **AUDIT-ONLY, never features** (`fullevent_dump_contract.py:36-37`; test `:119-121`).
- **F7 coherent 3-inventory bootstrap + identity/order hashes** are the alignment proof (FPS ROOTs carry **no stable event keys** on the MC side — `inventory_order_hash` is the substitute; `fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:222-246, 385-431`).
- **All 12 MEFHC playlists, extended FPS domain** `[0,30]×[0,120]` GeV, per-playlist flux (never a combined manifest — `AGENTS.md:120-124`). Gate-1B: 49,152,885 signal / 4,116,128 data / 564,591 background rows (`PET_UQ_REMEDIATION_STATUS.md:55-56`).

## 1. Availability & alignment matrix (data / signal-MC / truth-MC / background-MC / misses)

| Inventory | Present in G2 today | Reco observable schema | Truth schema | Native-miss handling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Signal MC (`mc_signal_reco`) | YES (49.15M) | `part_reco`, `reco_scalars`, `reco_muon(7)`, `reco_vertex(3)`, `reco_view`, `reco_time` | `part_gen(E,px,py,pz,pdg)`, `truth_scalars` | `!pass_reco` → cloud/view/time zeroed, muon/vertex −9999; truth-only rows appended |
| Data (`data`) | YES (4.12M) | `measured_pc`, `measured_scalars`, `data_muon(7)`, `data_vertex`, `data_view`, `data_time` | **none** (correct — no truth side) | all data pass reco |
| Truth MC (`mc_truth_denom`) | YES (== signal count) | — (denominator only) | truth cloud/scalars | is the miss source |
| Background MC (`mc_background`) | YES (0.56M) | `bkg_part_reco`, `bkg_reco_scalars`, `bkg_muon`, `bkg_vertex`, `bkg_view`, `bkg_time`, `w_bkg` + own identity/order | none (injected on reco side) | n/a |

**Finding A (alignment).** The proposal's new typed tokens must be dumped and row/token-aligned across **all four** inventories with identical column semantics, or the `assert_inventory_alignment` / identity-hash gates fail closed (`fullevent_dump_contract.py:70-112`). Any feature that exists for signal MC but not for data **and** background is disqualified — this is the single most common way a "richer" representation silently breaks the contract.

## 2. Provisional feature-provenance / risk matrix

Decision key: **INCLUDE** = contract-defensible now; **DEFER** = defensible in principle, blocked on a named dump/getter/parity artifact; **EXCLUDE** = keep as event feature / not a token, or redundant; **BLOCK** = contract violation, may not enter step-1 density ratio.

| # | Candidate feature | Definition / unit | Repo branch / object source | Reco-observable on **data**? | Decision | Evidence required to change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Muon token** px,py,pz,E,φ | GeV, GeV, rad | `mu_reco_{px,py,pz,E,phi}` (`dump_pointcloud_inputs.py:69-71`) | YES (MINOS-matched reco muon; data has real MINOS) | **INCLUDE** *(as feature; token form → see Finding B)* | — |
| 2 | Muon **charge** | sign(qp), q/p GeV⁻¹ | `mu_reco_qp` | YES | **INCLUDE** | — |
| 3 | Muon **MINOS match/range/curvature quality** | bool/float, reco-only | `mu_reco_minos_ok` (range/curvature = **unknown branch**) | YES (detector) | **INCLUDE** minos_ok; **DEFER** range/curvature | dumped `mu_reco_range`/`_curv_qual` + data/bkg parity |
| 4 | Reco **vertex** x,y,z | mm | `vtx_reco_{x,y,z}` | YES | **INCLUDE** | — |
| 5 | Recoil-cluster **view** | {X=1,U=2,V=3} categorical | `part_reco_view` | YES | **INCLUDE** (reco/step-1 only) | — |
| 6 | Recoil-cluster **timing** | ns (unit unconfirmed) | `part_reco_time` | YES | **INCLUDE**; unit LABELED UNKNOWN | confirm C++ unit/reference-t0 |
| 7 | Energy sums (recoil/visible E, multiplicity, discarded-overflow E) | GeV, count | derivable from `part_reco_*` full-length vectors | YES | **DEFER** | overflow/count summary dumped from pre-truncation vectors (Gregor's aggregate-token idea; `GREGOR_*:56-58`) |
| 8 | **Photon** typed token | reco EM-blob candidate | **NOT DUMPED** (reco cloud is generic (E,pos,z)) | plausibly yes (EM shower reco) | **BLOCK→DEFER** | new dump for **all 4 inventories** + proof the photon *type* is a **reco** classification, not truth PDG |
| 9 | **Blob** typed token | reco isolated neutral cluster | NOT DUMPED as typed | plausibly yes | **BLOCK→DEFER** | same as #8 |
| 10 | **Prong** typed token | reco track object | NOT DUMPED as typed | yes (tracking) | **BLOCK→DEFER** | same as #8 |
| 11 | **Token TYPE embedding** (muon/photon/blob/prong/pad) | categorical | none | n/a | **DEFER + guard** | padding index reserved distinct from every real type (**Finding C**) |
| 12 | **Reco PID hypothesis** (dE/dx-based p/π/μ) | categorical/score | reco dE/dx (**no branch**) | yes *if reco* | **DEFER** | dE/dx getter + branch + data parity; type must be reco-derived |
| 13 | **dE/dx** per token | MeV/cm | **NO BRANCH** | yes if reconstructed | **DEFER** | named getter + dump + all-inventory parity + unit |
| 14 | **Michel-electron flag** | delayed-cluster reco tag | **NO BRANCH** | YES (timing-tagged, reco) | **DEFER** | dump + data/bkg parity (reco tag, not truth e±) |
| 15 | **Pion-prong flag** | prong hadron-ID | source **UNKNOWN** | only if reco dE/dx/track | **DEFER, leakage-risk** | prove derived from **reco** track ID, not truth PDG |
| 16 | **Truth PDG** per truth token | PDG code | `part_gen[...,4]` | **N/A — truth** | **INCLUDE (step-2 truth cloud ONLY)** | never on reco/step-1 side (already `build_truth_cloud`) |
| 17 | **Interaction label** (CC/NC, QE/RES/DIS, inttype) | generator category | `bkg_inttype`, `bkg_current` (audit-only) | **NO** — MC bookkeeping | **BLOCK** | none — permanently non-observable on data |
| 18 | **Signal/background label** | class tag | truth/MC | NO | **BLOCK** | none |
| 19 | True ν energy / true vertex / true W into step-1 | GeV/mm | truth | NO | **BLOCK** | none (truth-vertex/W allowed in **event_truth** only, `contract:107-108`) |
| 20 | **Gregor-prepared rows / his selection** | pre-processed dataset | HF `gregorkrzmanc/minerva-ml` | — | **BLOCK** | must be rebuilt in-repo (Finding D) |
| 21 | **Pretrained weights** (OmniLearned / Gregor encoder) | init only | external | — | **DEFER** | init-only, must pass all gates; no prepared rows; Eavail offset reconciled (Finding E) |

## 3. Hard findings (adversarial)

**Finding B — muon as a *token* changes sentinel/mask semantics.** Today the muon is a FiLM event feature, zeroed post-normalization on `!pass_reco` and masked in step-1 loss (`fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:147-179`; contract `:125-133`). If PET2 promotes muon to a **cloud token**, the `!pass_reco`/native-miss event has **no reconstructed muon**: the token must be a *masked pad*, never a −9999-valued token (a −9999 token pollutes KNN geometry and the type embedding). 28.6M/49.2M rows are misses (`contract:126`). This is a **BLOCK until the mask path is proven**, because it directly interacts with native-miss handling — the pipeline's defining invariant.

**Finding C — type-index / padding-index collision (Gregor's own bug).** The reference explicitly warns Gregor's code "uses muon PID 0 while the embedding also treats 0 as padding — verify, and don't copy" (`GREGOR_*:59-61`). Current padding convention is `energy(col0)==0` (`contract:110-114`). Any type embedding **must reserve index 0 for pad** and shift all real types to ≥1, or padded tokens become indistinguishable from muons. **BLOCK** any embedding that does not.

**Finding D — Gregor's prepared rows/selection are contract-incompatible (HARD BLOCK).** His preprocessing "requires a MINOS-matched muon and filters interaction types" (`GREGOR_*:66-68`). That:
- destroys the **truth-authoritative denominator** and the **native-miss set** (MINOS-required drops real misses; the whole point is to *keep* truth-only events);
- drops **backgrounds and data** semantics (he does supervised regression, not density ratios / negweight injection);
- covers **playlists 1A/1B only**, not all 12 (`GREGOR_*:15-18`, `:66-70`);
- carries **no event identity/order** compatible with `inventory_order_hash`.
Reuse his *feature definitions and code patterns* only (`GREGOR_*:65-71`). **BLOCK** ingestion of his rows/checkpoint-preprocessing.

**Finding E — pretrained weights are init, not evidence, and coordinates are a forced fit.** OmniLearned uses collider `(η, φ, log pT)`; our reco tokens are **view-based detector clusters** where the contract fixes KNN coord = `(pos,z)` (`fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:94-98`; `GREGOR_*:63-64`). Pretraining does not violate the contract *per se*, but "representation can't buy acceptance" (`GREGOR_*:94-96`) and the **Eavail definition differs (~140 MeV/π± offset)** (`GREGOR_*:97-99`). **DEFER** to the controlled 4-arm pilot; it must win on **our gates** (omitted-muon stress, injected+ordinary closure, likelihood-ratio calibration, ESS/weight tails, prior swaps, high-W/low-q3), not validation loss.

**Finding F — PyTorch framework port must re-establish every invariant.** The entire contract surface (FPS-edge guard, three-schema leakage guard, sentinel/pass-mask zeroing, F7 coherent 3-inventory bootstrap with `pet_bootstrap.mc_poisson_factor` bit-consistency, Stay-Positive negweight injection ordering, identity/order hashes, fingerprint, reweight logit-cap in **logit space** — `contract:205-210`) currently lives in the **TF/numpy** dataloader. A PyTorch OmniFold loop is a **testable risk, not a blocker**, but every guard below must be re-implemented and re-tested against the *same* fixtures.

## 4. Invariant tests a later implementation/review MUST pass

Reuse the login-safe fixture pattern (`test_fullevent_gate2.py`, `test_fullevent_dump_contract.py`). New/extended tests:

1. **Reco/data schema parity, extended to typed tokens.** For every new token field (type, dE/dx, Michel, view, timing, PID), `assert_inventory_alignment` covers `{signal reco, data, background}` with identical column count/order/dtype; a field present on signal but absent on data OR background **fails closed**. (Extends `assert_inventory_alignment` `:70-96`.)
2. **No truth/MC-bookkeeping leakage into step-1.** Extend `assert_no_truth_leakage`: rebuild every reco/data token block from reco arrays only; assert exact match and inequality to any truth-built block. Assert `bkg_inttype/current/nuPDG` and interaction/CC-NC labels are **absent** from the reco feature tensor (regression of `AUDIT_ONLY_KEYS`, `:119-121`).
3. **Truth PID stays step-2 only.** Assert reco/data token tensor contains no PDG column; truth PDG present only in the gen cloud.
4. **Native-miss muon-token mask.** For `!pass_reco` rows: muon token is pad-masked (not −9999-valued), all cloud/view/time zeroed, and step-1 loss mask == `pass_reco`. Assert mean muon feature over pass_reco is finite/clean and the −9999 sentinel never enters a normalization statistic (regression of the −5732 bug, `contract:130-133`).
5. **Type-embedding padding reservation.** Assert pad index (0) ≠ any real type index; a fully-padded token maps to the pad embedding; muon type index ≠ 0 (Finding C).
6. **Overflow/aggregate-token conservation.** With >num_part tokens, assert summed energy + multiplicity of the overflow are preserved in an aggregate token; no silent top-N energy loss beyond the recorded discarded-E summary.
7. **NaN/±inf/missing-field fail-closed.** Any non-finite token feature or missing new-schema key raises before construction (extends `build_signed_measured_inventory:320-329`).
8. **FPS-edge + fingerprint guards unchanged.** `assert_extended_fps_edges` and `assert_publication_config` still fire; fingerprint stays `pet-fullevent-fps-v1`; a PyTorch estimator carries the same fingerprint or is rejected at assembly (`:439-469`).
9. **Background schema completeness.** Every new typed-token field appears in `BKG_KEYS`, POT-scaled negweight injection consumes it, and identity hash covers it; missing → fail closed (extends `fullevent_dump_contract.py:31-32`).
10. **F7 coherent 3-inventory replay under the new schema.** `validate_coherent_bootstrap` still proves signal+bkg factors are the global seed draw at persisted indices; expanding the token schema must not change the factor streams (`:385-431`).
11. **Density-ratio direction.** Step-1 sees only reco/data tensors incl. new tokens; step-2 sees only gen; a test that feeds a truth-only field into step-1 must fail the leakage guard.
12. **All-12-playlist + systematics smoke.** Each new feature is producible on all 12 playlists and has a defined behavior under at least the declared dominant vertical/flux universes (Gate-7 joint retrain); a feature with no systematic universe is flagged for the materiality gate, not silently trusted.

## 5. Verdict — hard blockers vs. testable risks

**Hard blockers (may not proceed until cleared):**
- **B1** Interaction/current/CC-NC/QE-RES-DIS labels or signal-vs-background labels as features — permanent BLOCK (MC bookkeeping, not observable on data). *(row 17-18)*
- **B2** Any token *type* / PID / prong / Michel / pion flag derived from **truth PDG** rather than reco — BLOCK (leakage). *(rows 8-12,15)*
- **B3** Photon/blob/prong typed tokens, dE/dx, Michel flag: **not dumped for any inventory today** — BLOCK until dumped **and** proven reco-observable and aligned across data + background + signal. *(rows 8-14)*
- **B4** Muon-as-cloud-token without a proven native-miss **mask** path (no −9999 tokens) — BLOCK. *(Finding B)*
- **B5** Type embedding without padding index reserved distinct from muon/all real types — BLOCK. *(Finding C)*
- **B6** Ingesting Gregor's prepared rows / MINOS-required, interaction-filtered selection / checkpoint preprocessing — BLOCK; rebuild in-repo preserving truth denominator, misses, backgrounds, data, all 12 playlists. *(Finding D)*
- **B7** Truth-only quantities (true ν E, true vertex, true W) entering step-1 — BLOCK; truth-vertex/W only in event_truth. *(row 19)*

**Testable risks (allowed to proceed with the §4 tests as gate):**
- **R1** PyTorch port fidelity of every contract guard (Finding F).
- **R2** Overflow/aggregate-token conservation and NaN/mask/count handling (tests 6-7).
- **R3** Pretrained-weight transfer (OmniLearned/Gregor encoder) as init only — win on our gates, reconcile Eavail offset, coordinate mismatch (Finding E, row 21). Higher AUC / more features / pretrained weights do **not** override B1-B7.
- **R4** Systematics coverage of each new reco observable under joint vertical/flux universes (test 12; Gate-7 materiality).
- **R5** POT/weight coherence of the expanded schema across the three-inventory negweight injection (tests 9-10).
- **R6** `time`/`dE/dx`/range-curvature **units and branch identities are LABELED UNKNOWN** — must be resolved before those rows move from DEFER to INCLUDE (rows 3,6,13).

I have not invented any counterpart the repository does not establish; unknowns are labeled as such. This audit blocks unsupported features (B1–B7) and does not concede the contract to a higher-AUC or pretrained arm.
